definition.en: The Life navigation envelope begins at 3.7 Ga as a conservative sampled biosignature boundary supported by biogenic-graphite evidence and extends to living Earth life at 0 Ma; 3.7 Ga is a minimum age by which life is evidenced, not a precise date for abiogenesis, LUCA or the origin of every lineage. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 生命导航范围从 37 亿年前开始，这是由生物成因石墨证据支持的保守采样生物标志边界，并延续到 0 Ma 的现存地球生命；37 亿年前表示已有生命证据的最低年龄，不是生命自然发生、最后普遍共同祖先或每条谱系起源的精确日期。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Carbon-isotope, geological and graphite-nanostructure analyses of 3.7 Ga Isua metasediments support a biogenic interpretation; an interdisciplinary review separates this biosignature boundary from the earlier and less certain habitability boundary.

limitations: The displayed 3.7 Ga boundary represents sampled biosignature evidence, not a resolved date for the origin of life or LUCA.
PBDB external identifier withheld: not-applicable-navigation-root.

definition.en: The Plantae root display uses the approximately 473–471 Ma Zanjón cryptospore assemblage as a sampled embryophyte-on-land anchor and extends to living representatives; it is not a first appearance for all Plantae or a crown-bryophyte record. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 植物界根节点以约 4.73–4.71 亿年前的 Zanjón 隐孢子组合为有胚植物登陆的采样锚点，并延伸到现生代表；它不是全部植物界的首现，也不是冠群苔藓植物记录。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Dated cryptospore monads and tetrads provide a direct sampled embryophyte-on-land anchor; living representatives supply the present endpoint.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: In the late Visean Glösa moss assemblage, Type I specimen KS27–074 is a nearly complete single-layered leaf with a central band of narrower cells and small pores in the periclinal walls; this fragmentary assemblage does not document complete plants or securely identify living moss taxa. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 在晚维宪期 Glösa 苔藓化石组合中，I 型标本 KS27–074 是一片近乎完整的单层细胞叶片，中央具有较窄细胞组成的带状区域，平周壁上有小孔；这一碎片化石组合未记录完整植株，也不能可靠地鉴定为现生苔藓分类单元。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Three late Visean moss morphotypes provide the direct fossil anchor; older cryptospores are not promoted to crown-moss records.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Lycopodiophyta is profiled at clade level, while Asteroxylon mackiei is used only as a species-level anatomical exemplar and not as a direct ancestor. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 本档案在演化支层级介绍石松类；Asteroxylon mackiei 仅作为物种层级的解剖实例，而非直系祖先。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: First and last appearances are rounded display ranges assembled for the atlas and remain sensitive to sampling and taxonomy.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: A morphology matrix of anatomically preserved Carboniferous Euramerican arborescent lycopsids tests relationships among Lepidodendrales; it neither identifies a direct ancestor nor establishes the order's global first or last appearance. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 石炭纪欧美大陆木本石松类的解剖形态矩阵检验了鳞木目内部关系；它既未识别直接祖先，也未确定该目的全球首现或末现。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The former 359–299 Ma display is withheld because the sampled Carboniferous matrix does not define a global range for a stable Lepidodendron concept.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB lineage is incompatible with the local expected parent Lycopodiophyta; external occurrence queries are withheld.

definition.en: The Pteridophyta atlas root retains a 385–0 Ma navigation envelope anchored by the Middle Devonian Wattieza–Eospermatopteris cladoxylopsid reconstruction; the fern-like body plan is not a crown-fern, crown-horsetail or direct-ancestor claim. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 蕨类植物图集根节点保留 3.85 亿年前至今的导航包络，以中泥盆世 Wattieza–Eospermatopteris 枝蕨类复原为锚点；蕨状体型不等于冠群真蕨、冠群木贼或直系祖先主张。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Attached Wattieza crowns and Eospermatopteris trunks directly reconstruct a fern-like cladoxylopsid tree while leaving crown relationships unresolved.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: In the phylogeny recovered by Elgorriaga and colleagues, the lineage containing Equisetaceae and Neocalamites shows a proposed trend toward smaller size and more compact strobili; combinations resembling modern horsetail traits were present by the Jurassic. This trend depends on that branching hypothesis and does not describe every member of Equisetopsida. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 在 Elgorriaga 等人恢复的系统发育关系中，包含木贼科与 Neocalamites 的谱系呈现体型缩小、孢子穗趋于紧凑的推断趋势；到侏罗纪，已出现近似现代木贼的性状组合。该趋势依赖这一分支假说，不代表所有木贼类共有的体制。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Elgorriaga et al. synthesize a Devonian sphenopsid fossil history and sample fossil and living horsetails; ICS supplies the Famennian numerical boundary.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB lineage is incompatible with the local expected parent Pteridophyta; external occurrence queries are withheld.

definition.en: A four-gene supermatrix resolves many sampled fern relationships while retaining poorly supported branches; the result describes an extant-heavy sample, not a complete Filicopsida history or fossil range. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 四基因超级矩阵解析了许多取样蕨类关系，同时保留若干低支持分支；该结果描述的是偏重现生类群的样本，不是完整的真蕨类历史或化石范围。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The former 360–0 Ma display is withheld because the systematic review distinguishes questionable Devonian fern-like plants from firmer Lower Carboniferous filicalean evidence.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB external identifier withheld: accepted-name-mismatch.

definition.en: The Gymnospermae atlas root uses a rounded 365–0 Ma total-seed-plant navigation envelope, anchored by Famennian cupulate seeds and living gymnosperm families; it is not the fossil first appearance or crown age of extant Gymnospermae. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 裸子植物图集根节点采用取整后的 3.65 亿年前至今总群种子植物导航包络，以法门期杯状种子和现生裸子植物各科为锚点；它不是现生裸子植物的化石首现或冠群年龄。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Cupulate lagenostomalean-type seeds anchor the extinct total-group record; complete living-family sampling contextualizes the present endpoint.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB external identifier withheld: accepted-rank-mismatch.

definition.en: Coiro et al. combine molecular data from living cycads with leaf morphology from living and fossil taxa in a Bayesian total-evidence analysis to study cycad biogeographic history; its sampled topology is not an immutable total-group topology. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Coiro 等将现生苏铁的分子数据与现生及化石类群的叶部形态结合，在贝叶斯全证据分析中研究苏铁的生物地理历史；其取样拓扑不是不可变的全群拓扑。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Coiro et al. integrate 60 fossil species with living cycads and estimate crown Cycadales at median 330.4 Ma; 0 Ma denotes living members.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB lineage is incompatible with the local expected parent Gymnospermae; external occurrence queries are withheld.

definition.en: Ginkgoxylon liaoningense is used as a Ginkgo-like wood exemplar within Ginkgophyta context; it is not assigned as a direct ancestor of Ginkgo biloba. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Ginkgoxylon liaoningense 在银杏类语境中作为银杏样木材实例使用；不将其归为银杏（Ginkgo biloba）的直系祖先。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Jiang et al. date and diagnose Ginkgoxylon liaoningense from the 153–165 Ma Tiaojishan Formation; 0 Ma denotes living Ginkgo.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB lineage is incompatible with the local expected parent Gymnospermae; external occurrence queries are withheld.

definition.en: Leslie et al. assembled an age-calibrated phylogeny sampling about 80% of living conifer species to compare sampled hemispheric clades; this molecular tree is not a complete total-group taxonomy, direct ancestor sequence or fossil occurrence ledger. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Leslie 等构建了一个经年代校准、取样约 80% 现生松柏类物种的系统树，用于比较所采样的南北半球支系；这棵分子树不是完整总群分类、直系祖先序列或化石出现清单。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Leslie et al. review an extensive conifer fossil record spanning more than 300 Myr and explicitly caution that extant molecular samples omit extinct diversity.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB lineage is incompatible with the local expected parent Gymnospermae; external occurrence queries are withheld.

definition.en: Escapa and Catalano analyze 39 araucariacean species—31 living and eight fossil—using molecular and morphological characters; the recovered family relationships are sampled matrix results, not direct ancestry or an exhaustive record of Araucariaceae. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Escapa 与 Catalano 以分子和形态性状分析了 39 个南洋杉科物种——31 个现生、8 个化石；所得科内关系是取样矩阵结果，不是直系祖先关系，也不是南洋杉科的穷尽记录。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Axsmith et al. describe specimen J 1430 from the Hettangian South Hadley Falls Member as a bona fide Araucariaceae megafossil; 0 Ma denotes living family members.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB lineage is incompatible with the local expected parent Coniferophyta; external occurrence queries are withheld.

definition.en: Angiospermae is treated as the flowering-plant clade; fossil placements and calibration densities remain analytical inputs rather than direct ancestor assignments. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 被子植物在此作为开花植物演化支处理；化石位置和校准概率密度仍是分析输入，并非直系祖先归属判定。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: First and last appearances are rounded display ranges assembled for the atlas and remain sensitive to sampling and taxonomy.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Cratolirion bognerianum was recovered as a crown monocot without an uncontested living-family assignment; it is not presented as a direct ancestor. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 分析将 Cratolirion bognerianum 恢复为冠群单子叶植物，但其现生科归属尚无无争议结论；本档案不将它视为直系祖先。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Cratolirion bognerianum provides an approximately 115 Ma crown-monocot occurrence with root-to-reproductive anatomy.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: The sampled plastid phylogeny resolves major grass lineages and maps multiple C4 origins, but its reconstructed topology does not date Poaceae or imply one ancestral C4 transition. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 采样的质体系统发育分析解析了主要禾草谱系，并映射出多次 C4 起源；但重建拓扑不能确定禾本科年代，也不表示只发生过一次祖先 C4 转变。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Prasad et al. report latest-Cretaceous phytolith morphotypes assigned to at least five living-grass subclades; 0 Ma denotes living Poaceae.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB lineage is incompatible with the local expected parent Monocotyledones; external occurrence queries are withheld.

definition.en: Leefructus mirus is diagnosed as a basal eudicot from the Early Cretaceous Yixian Formation, while a separate 83-plastid-gene analysis resolves selected living early eudicot branches; neither result is a literal ancestor sequence. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 早白垩世义县组的 Leefructus mirus 被鉴定为基部真双子叶植物；另一项独立的 83 个质体基因分析解析了所选现生早分化真双子叶植物分支。两项结果都不等于实际的祖先序列。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Sun et al. diagnose Leefructus as a basal eudicot and report multiple radiometric dates bounding its bed at 122.6–125.8 Ma; 0 Ma denotes living eudicots.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB external identifier withheld: no-exact-name-in-snapshot.

definition.en: A taxonomically broad legume phylogeny supports six subfamilies and replaces the traditional broad Caesalpinioideae arrangement; this is a sampled classification, not a Fabaceae origin date. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 广泛取样的豆科系统树支持六个亚科并取代传统广义苏木亚科安排；这是取样分类方案，并非豆科起源年代。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Lyson et al. document the Corral Bluffs fruit and leaflets at 65.35 Ma; Koenen et al. identify this as the oldest unequivocal legume fossil while treating deeper divergence as model-dependent.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB lineage is incompatible with the local expected parent Eudicotyledones; external occurrence queries are withheld.

definition.en: Metzgeriothallus sharonae supports a liverwort body-fossil assignment, while older Ordovician spore masses only suggest and do not establish Marchantiophyta affinity. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Metzgeriothallus sharonae 支持苔类实体化石的归属判定；更早的奥陶纪孢子团仅提示、并未确立与地钱门的亲缘关系。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Metzgeriothallus sharonae provides a Givetian liverwort body-fossil anchor; older cryptospore and sporangial evidence remains affinity-bounded.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Li and colleagues illustrate sporophytes, gametophytes and stomata of Anthoceros agrestis Bonn; these named living materials provide a morphological example for hornworts, without establishing that every hornwort species has identical structures or resolving stomatal homology across land plants. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Li 及同事展示了 Anthoceros agrestis Bonn 品系的孢子体、配子体和气孔；这些具名现生材料提供了角苔的形态实例，但不能证明所有角苔物种具有完全相同的结构，也未解决陆生植物间气孔的同源性问题。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The former 470–0 Ma display is withheld rather than converting extant genome sampling into a phylum first appearance.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB external identifier withheld: accepted-rank-mismatch.

definition.en: Edwards established Aglaophyton for the plant formerly called Rhynia major after re-examining new and historical material; the profile preserves the paper's refusal to assign the genus to a living higher group. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Edwards 在重新检视新材料与历史材料后，为原称 Rhynia major 的植物建立 Aglaophyton；本档案保留论文不将该属归入任何现生高阶类群的处理。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The anatomical redescription identifies Aglaophyton major in the Rhynie Chert, while the independent ID-TIMS study constrains the Rhynie Outlier with a 411.5 ± 1.3 Ma zircon age.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Kenrick and Long verified Horneophyton lignieri in a 24-section museum sample and selected three named NHMUK slides for detailed imaging; the profile does not turn the study's evolutionary interpretation into direct ancestry. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Kenrick 与 Long 在含 24 张切片的馆藏样本中核验 Horneophyton lignieri，并选择三张具名 NHMUK 切片进行详细成像；本档案不把研究的演化解释改写为直接祖先关系。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The confocal study identifies Horneophyton lignieri in named Rhynie-chert slides, while the independent ID-TIMS study constrains the Rhynie Outlier with a 411.5 ± 1.3 Ma zircon age.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: The 635–0 Ma Invertebrata route is an evidence anthology, not a clade range: CA–ID–TIMS dates place Avalon animal assemblages by about 571 Ma, while represented living groups continue to the present; 635 Ma remains an Ediacaran display ceiling rather than an invertebrate FAD. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 635–0 Ma 的“无脊椎动物”路线是证据选集而非演化支范围：CA–ID–TIMS 年代把阿瓦隆动物群约束到约 571 Ma，而所代表的现生类群延续至今；635 Ma 只是埃迪卡拉纪展示上限，不是无脊椎动物全球首现。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: An informal anthology spans dated Avalon animal assemblages and represented living groups without treating Invertebrata as a clade.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB external identifier withheld: no-exact-name-in-snapshot.

definition.en: The Porifera root display uses 551–0 Ma as a sampled navigation envelope from the older bound of the 551–539 Ma Helicolocellus-bearing Dengying interval to living sponges; its crown placement is morphology-matrix dependent and does not establish the phylum's origin. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 多孔动物门根节点采用 5.51 亿年前至今的采样导航包络，从含 Helicolocellus 的 5.51–5.39 亿年前灯影组区间上界延伸到现生海绵；其冠群位置依赖形态矩阵，不能确定该门的起源。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Helicolocellus specimens preserve a nested organic lattice in a dated interval and are recovered near Hexactinellida in the sampled matrix.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Comparative skeletal anatomy supports interpreting stromatoporoids as sponge-grade organisms in the reviewed material, but affinity and character homology remain historical systematic inferences rather than a fixed crown placement. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 比较骨骼解剖支持把综述材料中的层孔虫解释为海绵型生物，但其亲缘与性状同源仍是历史系统学推断，而非固定的冠群位置。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The former 485–359 Ma display is withheld because a scalar interval would erase the major post-Devonian gap and the grade-level taxonomic problem.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Cryogenian sterane records used on the Demospongiae route are a contested geochemical attribution to sponge-grade sources; they do not establish a demosponge crown origin, body fossil or global first appearance. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 寻常海绵路线采用的成冰纪甾烷记录，是对海绵型来源存在争议的地球化学归因；它不确立寻常海绵冠群起源、体化石或全球首现。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Love et al. report Cryogenian 24-isopropylcholestanes, while Nettersheim et al. demonstrate non-sponge precursor production; the present endpoint denotes living demosponges.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

names.zh: 大堡礁海绵基因组物种

definition.en: Srivastava et al. report a draft genome from the living demosponge Amphimedon queenslandica; it contains many metazoan signalling, transcription-factor, adhesion and cell-cycle gene families despite the adult sponge lacking eumetazoan organs. This sampled genome does not represent a literal ancestral animal or all Porifera. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Srivastava 等报告了现生寻常海绵 Amphimedon queenslandica 的草图基因组；尽管成体海绵缺少真后生动物器官，该基因组仍包含许多后生动物信号、转录因子、黏附和细胞周期基因家族。这个取样基因组不代表字面意义的祖先动物或全部海绵动物。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The 0–0 placeholder is withheld because the genome paper supplies a living sample and comparative biology, not species-level range evidence.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB external identifier withheld: no-exact-name-in-snapshot.

definition.en: Hexactinellida is displayed at 536–0 Ma only as a basal-Cambrian-spicule-to-living navigation anthology: the Soltanieh material is a cautious fossil anchor, not an exact crown-Hexactinellida FAD or continuous occupancy record. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Hexactinellida 的 536–0 Ma 仅作为“寒武纪初期骨针—现生类群”导航汇编：索尔塔尼耶材料是谨慎的化石锚点，不是冠群六放海绵的精确首现或连续占据记录。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Antcliffe et al. reassess early sponge candidates and retain basal-Cambrian siliceous spicules as reliable; 0 Ma denotes living hexactinellids.

definition.en: The 558–0 Ma Mollusca display is a navigation envelope anchored at its old end by White Sea Kimberella morphology and at its young end by living molluscs; it is not a crown-Mollusca origin, a continuous fossil record or a direct-ancestor claim. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 558–0 Ma 的软体动物显示范围是导航包络：老端由白海 Kimberella 形态证据锚定，年轻端由现生软体动物锚定；它不是软体动物冠群起源、连续化石记录或直接祖先主张。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Teaching-navigation envelope linking living Mollusca to a separately qualified mollusc-like Ediacaran dossier.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Pojetaia shell sections document a laminar inner microstructure in one Cambrian bivalve sample; they do not establish the global Bivalvia first appearance or continuous class range. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Pojetaia 贝壳切片记录了一例寒武纪双壳类样本的层状内微结构；它不确立双壳纲全球首现或连续纲级范围。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Vendrasco et al. document Pojetaia shell material from probably Botomian and lowermost Botomian units; ICS v2026/06 supplies the conservative Stage 4 numerical envelope.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: A 41-shell-character cladistic analysis tests relationships among sampled rudists (Hippuritida/Hippuritoida); the resulting trees do not define the group's complete geographic or temporal range. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 一项 41 个贝壳性状的支序分析检验了取样厚壳蛤类（Hippuritida/Hippuritoida）的关系；所得系统树不界定该群完整地理或年代范围。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: No secondary summary or general background statement is promoted into a global rudist range without a range-fit primary locator.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: COI sequences from sampled pteriomorph bivalves test oyster relationships and historical higher ranks; a single mitochondrial locus cannot settle every Ostreoida relationship or fossil endpoint. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 取样翼形亚纲双壳类的 COI 序列检验了牡蛎关系与历史高级阶元；单一线粒体位点不能解决所有牡蛎目关系或化石端点。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The source is fit for the sampled molecular topology, not a global historical range.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Vendrasco et al. treat the studied shell material as Pojetaia runnegari; the profile retains that species-level identification while keeping bivalve-wide evolutionary placement conditional. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Vendrasco 等将所研究的贝壳材料归入 Pojetaia runnegari；本档案保留该物种级鉴定，同时将双壳纲范围的演化位置保持为有条件的比较结论。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The study documents more than fifty Pojetaia specimens from probably Botomian and lowermost Botomian units; ICS v2026/06 supplies the conservative Stage 4 bounds.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Phylogenomic analyses recover major sampled gastropod branches and reject Orthogastropoda; several alternative deep relationships remain sensitive to matrix construction and model choice. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 系统基因组分析恢复了主要取样腹足类支系并否定 Orthogastropoda；若干替代深层关系仍对矩阵构建和模型选择敏感。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Living phylogenomic sampling cannot be silently converted into a fossil FAD or a clade duration.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: A multigene phylogeny of sampled living cephalopods supports repeated convergence associated with habitat shifts; extinct cephalopods and the exact ancestral habitats are not directly sampled. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 取样现生头足类的多基因系统树支持与生境转换相关的多次趋同；灭绝头足类和确切祖先生境并未直接取样。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The source supports a sampled living topology and habitat reconstruction, not a fossil range.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Living Allonautilus anatomy supports a distinct genus within Nautilida and informs comparisons with selected fossils; it cannot resolve or temporally bound the broader historical Nautiloidea grouping. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 现生异鹦鹉螺解剖支持其作为鹦鹉螺目内独立属，并用于同部分化石比较；它不能解析或限定更广义历史 Nautiloidea 类群的年代。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Genus-level living anatomy and Nautilida relationships do not time-bound Nautiloidea.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: A cladistic analysis of ammonoids spanning the Permian–Triassic boundary tests survival and turnover in that sampled interval; it neither covers all Ammonoidea nor fixes their origin and extinction endpoints. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 跨二叠纪—三叠纪界线的菊石支序分析检验了该取样区间的存续与更替；它既不覆盖全部菊石亚纲，也不确定其起源和灭绝端点。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The paper directly analyzes Middle–Late Permian and Induan ammonoids across the Permian–Triassic boundary; current ICS boundaries convert that named interval to numerical ages.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Korn et al. describe an early Late Viséan Moroccan ammonoid assemblage within Goniatitida; the atlas conservatively displays the enclosing Viséan interval, 346.7–330.3 Ma, as a study-sample window rather than an order-wide FAD or LAD. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Korn 等描述了棱菊石目内一个来自摩洛哥、时代为维宪期晚期早段的菊石组合；图谱保守显示包容它的整个维宪期 3.467–3.303 亿年前，作为研究样本窗口，而非该目的全球首现或末现。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Korn et al. directly describe an early Late Viséan assemblage within Goniatitida; ICS v2026/06 supplies the enclosing Viséan numerical bounds.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Early internal-shell characters are used to infer relationships near the origin of sampled Ceratitida; this comparative inference is not a directly observed ancestor or a complete global first appearance. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 早期内壳性状被用于推断取样齿菊石目近起源关系；这一比较推断不是直接观察的祖先，也不是完整全球首现。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Shigeta et al. explicitly state that Ceratitida ranged from the Early Permian to the end of the Triassic.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: An integrated conch-character analysis resolves relationships within sampled Hildoceratidae; this family-level result supplies an Ammonitida case study rather than an order-wide tree or range. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 整合壳体性状分析解析了取样 Hildoceratidae 内部关系；这一科级结果是菊石目案例，而不是目级系统树或范围。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Bardin et al. analyze a 105-taxon Hildoceratidae matrix explicitly scoped to the Early Jurassic; ICS v2026/06 supplies the period boundaries.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Fossil-calibrated molecular clocks infer Mesozoic turnover and diversification among sampled modern coleoids; posterior node ages are model estimates, not fossil first appearances or the total Coleoidea origin. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 化石校准分子钟推断取样现代鞘亚纲在中生代发生更替和多样化；节点后验年龄是模型估计，不是化石首现或整个鞘亚纲起源。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Model-dependent node estimates are not silently substituted for a fossil range.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: A Bayesian tip-dated morphology analysis tests relationships and diversification in sampled belemnites; topology and node ages remain conditional on character coding, fossil ages and priors. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 贝叶斯端点定年形态分析检验了取样箭石的关系与多样化；拓扑和节点年代仍以性状编码、化石年龄和先验为条件。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Stevens et al. publish the sampled species, first and last occurrence inputs, a 253.1 Ma origin offset and the terminal K–Pg extinction context.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Albertin et al. sequenced genomic DNA from one living male Octopus bimaculoides and used 12 RNA transcriptomes from tissue and developmental samples to annotate the assembly. These are present-day research samples, not dates for species origin, fossil first appearance or complete geographic range. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Albertin 等对一只现生雄性加州双斑蛸的基因组 DNA 测序，并用组织及发育样本的 12 个 RNA 转录组注释组装。这些是当代研究样本，不为物种起源、化石首现或完整地理范围定年。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Albertin et al. document genomic DNA from one living male, 12 RNA transcriptomes from tissue and developmental samples, and associated BioProjects.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: The molluscan-origin dossier is a navigation route through contested Kimberella affinity and the Orthrozanclus character mosaic; it does not define crown Mollusca, a direct ancestor chain or a global origin date. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 软体动物起源档案是穿过有争议 Kimberella 亲缘与 Orthrozanclus 性状镶嵌的导航路线；它不定义软体动物冠群、直接祖先链或全球起源年代。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: A taxon range would be a category error; the linked fossil dossiers remain independently accessible through their own evidence records.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Kimberella quadrata shows mollusc-like characters in the White Sea sample, but the profile does not assign crown-Mollusca membership or direct ancestry. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 白海样本中的 Kimberella quadrata 显示出软体动物样特征，但本档案不据此判定其属于冠群软体动物或具有直系祖先关系。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: More than 35 late Ediacaran body fossils test a mollusc-like interpretation without preserving a crown diagnosis.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Odontogriphus omalus is treated as an interpretation-bounded molluscan-origin dossier; tooth-row homology does not by itself establish crown membership or ancestry. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Odontogriphus omalus 在此作为受解释边界约束的软体动物起源档案；齿列同源性本身不能确立冠群归属或祖先关系。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: A 189-specimen sample reveals repeated tooth rows, a broad foot and mantle-groove structures.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: One articulated Orthrozanclus body combines an anterior shell, three sclerite zones and marginal spines; Halwaxiida placement is a character-matrix hypothesis, not observed molluscan ancestry. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 一件关节相连的 Orthrozanclus 躯体结合前部壳、三带骨片和边缘棘；Halwaxiida 位置是性状矩阵假说，并非已观察软体动物祖先关系。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: No museum overview or secondary age page is used to manufacture a numerical endpoint absent from the located primary study.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Nectocaris pteryx was interpreted as a soft-bodied cephalopod in the cited study, but absent diagnostic hard parts and feeding structures keep that placement contested. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 所引研究将 Nectocaris pteryx 解释为软躯体头足类，但缺少诊断性硬体部分和摄食结构，使这一分类位置仍有争议。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Ninety newly prepared specimens reveal a funnel, fins, eyes and two tentacles but no diagnostic hard-part series.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Transcriptome–genome matrices recover sampled Polyplacophora plus Aplacophora as Aculifera, but omitted Monoplacophora and alternative matrices limit this to a study-specific living-taxon topology. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 转录组—基因组矩阵把取样多板纲与无板类恢复为有棘类，但缺少单板纲且替代矩阵不同，因此仅代表研究特定的现生类群拓扑。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Topology support is retained separately and is not converted into temporal occurrence evidence.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: A mitogenomic analysis adds 13 chiton genomes and tests sampled Polyplacophora relationships; mitochondrial inheritance and calibration uncertainty limit deep topology and timing. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.

definition.en: Phylogenomic analyses test relationships among sampled solenogasters and caudofoveates, but the atlas label Aplacophora remains a historical navigation grade rather than an assumed globally bounded natural clade. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 系统基因组分析检验了取样沟腹类与尾腔类关系，但图谱标签 Aplacophora 仍是历史导航等级，不被假定为具有全球边界的自然支系。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: A phylogenomic topology cannot supply temporal endpoints for a historically unstable grouping.

definition.en: An all-living-class phylogenomic sample recovers Monoplacophora with Cephalopoda in principal analyses; the result conflicts with other matrices and is not a fossil range or universal consensus. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 覆盖全部现生纲的系统基因组样本在主要分析中把单板纲与头足纲恢复为一支；该结果与其他矩阵冲突，不是化石范围或普遍共识。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Study-specific living relationships do not establish the lineage’s origin or fossil duration.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Scaphopoda is included in a phylogenomic sample of all major living molluscan classes, but its deep placement varies with matrix and model and does not establish scaphopod origin or fossil endpoints. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 掘足纲被纳入覆盖主要现生软体动物纲的系统基因组样本，但其深层位置随矩阵和模型变化，不能确立掘足纲起源或化石端点。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The source supports sampled topology only, not a temporal range.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: The Arthropoda root display replaces the unsupported 540 Ma value with a 521–0 Ma sampled navigation envelope anchored by widespread trilobites, a contained arthropod clade, and living arthropods; it does not date the origin of Arthropoda. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 节肢动物门根节点以 5.21 亿年前至今的采样导航包络替代缺乏支持的 5.40 亿年前数值，锚点是作为其内部类群的广布三叶虫及现生节肢动物；它不用于测定节肢动物门的起源。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The approximately 521 Ma widespread trilobite record supplies a direct, conservative minimum for the broader arthropod root.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Parioscorpio venator is documented from the Silurian Waukesha Lagerstatte in Wisconsin, including holotype UWGM 2162 and paratype UWGM 2163. Its 2021 redescription rejected the scorpion interpretation while leaving exact arthropod affinities unresolved; this occurrence does not date scorpion origins. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Parioscorpio venator 见于威斯康星州志留纪沃基肖化石库，包括正模 UWGM 2162 和副模 UWGM 2163。2021 年重新描述否定了蝎类解释，但其在节肢动物中的确切亲缘位置仍未确定；这一产出不能用于蝎类起源定年。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The displayed interval is bounded to the cited dossier sample or model and does not establish a global first appearance, origin or uninterrupted lineage.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: The Trilobita root display retains a rounded 521–252 Ma sampled envelope: approximately 521 Ma marks the widespread early record, and revised Changhsingian material documents survival into the latest Permian; neither endpoint is an exact global FAD or LAD. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 三叶虫纲根节点保留取整后的 5.21–2.52 亿年前采样包络：约 5.21 亿年前代表广布的早期记录，重新研究的长兴期材料证明其延续到二叠纪最晚期；两个端点都不是精确的全球首现或末现。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: An early-trilobite matrix and clock analysis constrains the older record, while revised Changhsingian material constrains survival into the latest Permian.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Siluro-Devonian phacopid morphology and ontogeny provide an explicit worked sample for diagnosing species within Phacopida. The study samples Phacopidae and neither revises every phacopid lineage nor fixes order-wide temporal endpoints. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 志留纪—泥盆纪镜眼虫科的形态与个体发育材料，为镜眼虫目内部的物种识别提供了一个明确实例。该研究只抽样镜眼虫科，既未修订镜眼虫目的全部谱系，也未确定全目的时间端点。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The former 488–359 Ma display is withheld because the available primary study treats Siluro-Devonian Phacopidae rather than an order-wide first and last occurrence synthesis.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Fortey's order-level review documents that traditional Ptychopariida is a problematic, probably paraphyletic assemblage used in historical trilobite classification. This entity is therefore a historical navigation grade, not a demonstrated clade, ancestor or globally bounded lineage. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 目级综述指出，传统“褶颊虫目”是三叶虫历史分类中问题较多、很可能并系的组合。因此该实体只是历史导航级，不是已证实的演化支、祖先或具有全球端点的谱系。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The former 521–443 Ma display is withheld because the systematic review treats the traditional order as a problematic, probably paraphyletic assemblage rather than one bounded lineage.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: A cladistic revision of Missisquoiidae provides a documented family-level sample nested within Corynexochida. The family sample does not resolve every corynexochid relationship or establish the order's origin and extinction boundaries. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 对 Missisquoiidae 的支序修订提供了一个归入裂肋虫目的科级样本。这一科级样本不能解决裂肋虫目的全部关系，也不能确定该目的起源与灭绝边界。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The former 516–393 Ma display is withheld because the available cladistic revision covers one family and does not audit the complete temporal extent of Corynexochida.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: The trilobite evidence-samples entity is a navigation group linking the early-trilobite morphology matrix and approximately 521 Ma widespread sampled record to specimen dossiers. temporalRange.basis: Oesolcucumaria eostre preserves a diagnostic calcareous ring and articulated anatomy in the late Darriwilian Holothurian Bed. Proposed Cambrian holothurians lack comparable diagnostic support.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: The 516–0 Ma Hemichordata route is anchored by the approximately 516 Ma Yunotubus pterobranch sample and living Rhabdopleura observations; it is a represented-lineage span, not the phylum’s origin or a global hemichordate FAD. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 516–0 Ma 的半索动物路线由约 516 Ma 的 Yunotubus 羽鳃类样本和现生 Rhabdopleura 观察共同锚定；它是所代表谱系的证据跨度，不是该门起源或全球首现。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Diagnostic Yunotubus morphology anchors an early pterobranch minimum and living Rhabdopleura observations establish represented survival to the present.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Yunotubus combines fusellar tubes, zooids and a connecting stolon recovered within Pterobranchia by sampled morphology matrices, while that placement remains a scored phylogenetic hypothesis rather than observed ancestry. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Yunotubus 结合了半环状生长构造管、个虫和连接匍匐茎，并在取样形态矩阵中落入羽鳃类；该位置仍是性状评分的系统发育假说，而非观察到的祖先关系。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Five Yunotubus specimens from Cambrian Stage 3 preserve fusellar tubes, zooids and a stolon; living pterobranchs establish survival to the present.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: The Graptolithina root display uses 516–0 Ma as a sampled envelope from diagnostic Yunotubus material in the approximately 516 Ma Hongjingshao Formation to living rhabdopleurid graptolites; it is not a graptolite origin date. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 笔石纲根节点采用 5.16 亿年前至今的采样包络，从洪井哨组约 5.16 亿年前具有鉴别特征的 Yunotubus 材料延伸到现生杆壁虫类笔石；它不是笔石起源时间。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Five Yunotubus specimens preserve tubes, zooids and a connecting stolon used in a sampled pterobranch analysis; living rhabdopleurids support the present endpoint.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB external identifier withheld: accepted-rank-mismatch.

definition.en: The 520–0 Ma Vertebrata route uses a rounded Cambrian navigation ceiling, while Lower Cambrian Chengjiang Myllokunmingia and Haikouichthys material at approximately 518 Ma supplies its direct fossil anchor; neither value dates crown Vertebrata or establishes a global FAD. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 脊椎动物 5.20 亿年至今的路线采用取整后的寒武纪导航上限，而约 5.18 亿年前的澄江 Myllokunmingia 与 Haikouichthys 材料构成直接化石锚点；两者都不等于脊椎动物冠群年代或全球首现。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Myllokunmingia and Haikouichthys specimens and a sampled morphology matrix provide the approximately 518 Ma fossil anchor; the older display ceiling preserves nested Cambrian navigation and living vertebrates extend the route to the present.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: The atlas begins the historical Agnatha navigation grade at a rounded 520 Ma to include the Chengjiang Myllokunmingia and Haikouichthys specimens described as agnathan-grade vertebrates; 0 Ma reflects living cyclostomes in the display group, not a monophyletic crown range, global first appearance or direct ancestry. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 图谱把历史性的无颌类导航等级从约 5.20 亿年前开始，以纳入澄江生物群中被描述为无颌脊椎动物等级的 Myllokunmingia 与 Haikouichthys 标本；0 Ma 只表示该显示组包含现生圆口类，不代表单系冠群范围、全球首现或直系祖先。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Myllokunmingia and Haikouichthys provide a primary-study Cambrian anchor for the historical agnathan-grade display; the envelope is not a global FAD or ancestry claim.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB external identifier withheld: accepted-rank-mismatch.

definition.en: A systematic review integrates conodont soft tissues, feeding apparatuses and character evidence to assess vertebrate and chordate affinity. The synthesis supports a biological-affinity framework but not one exact origin date, direct ancestor or complete conodont range. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 系统综述整合牙形石软体、摄食器和性状证据，以评估其脊椎动物与脊索动物亲缘。该综合支持生物亲缘框架，但不提供唯一精确的起源日期、直接祖先或完整延限。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: No global interval is displayed until a concept-specific occurrence synthesis supplies independently located older and younger bounds.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB lineage is incompatible with the local expected parent Agnatha; external occurrence queries are withheld.

definition.en: A craniate phylogenetic review separates traditional armored fossil ‘agnathans’ among several lineages on the jawed-vertebrate stem. Ostracodermi is therefore retained only as a historical navigation grade, not a monophyletic taxon, direct ancestor or globally bounded range. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 颅动物系统综述把传统披甲化石“无颌类”分置于有颌脊椎动物干系的多个谱系。因此“甲胄鱼类”仅保留为历史导航级，不是单系分类单元、直接祖先或具有全球边界的延限。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The former 485–359 Ma composite is withheld rather than presented as the duration of a natural lineage.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB external identifier withheld: accepted-name-mismatch.

definition.en: A revised morphology matrix provides an explicit phylogenetic hypothesis across sampled Heterostraci. The topology does not convert stratigraphic sampling into an exact group origin, extinction date or ancestor sequence. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 修订后的形态矩阵为所抽样异甲类提供了明确的系统假说。该拓扑不能把地层抽样转化为精确的全群起源、灭绝日期或祖先序列。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The Silurian–Early Devonian window summarizes the dated taxa used in the whole-group analysis, not the exact duration of Heterostraci.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB lineage is incompatible with the local expected parent Ostracodermi; external occurrence queries are withheld.

definition.en: Genus-level observations and a morphology matrix test osteostracan phylogeny, classification and character polarity. The analysis is a sampled systematic hypothesis and does not directly establish temporal endpoints for Osteostraci. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 属级观察和形态矩阵检验了骨甲鱼类的系统关系、分类与性状极性。该分析是抽样的系统假说，不能直接确立骨甲鱼类的时间端点。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The interval follows the stratigraphic distribution of sampled genera and does not claim exact clade endpoints.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB external identifier withheld: accepted-rank-mismatch.
PBDB lineage is incompatible with the local expected parent Ostracodermi; external occurrence queries are withheld.

definition.en: Tujiaaspis vividus is a galeaspid represented by articulated Huixingshao Formation material; its placement is a published phylogenetic interpretation and is not presented as direct ancestry to jawed vertebrates. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Tujiaaspis vividus 是由回星哨组关节相连材料代表的盔甲鱼类；其系统位置来自已发表的系统发育解释，不被表述为有颌脊椎动物的直接祖先。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Holotype IVPP V26668 and figured paratypes IVPP V27410–V27411 are articulated Huixingshao Formation specimens. The numeric window only converts the published Telychian horizon to the atlas time scale.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: 28S and 18S rDNA from living lampreys and hagfishes support cyclostome monophyly in the sampled analyses. Extant sequence topology does not set the cyclostome fossil first appearance, divergence date or direct ancestry. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 现生七鳃鳗和盲鳗的 28S、18S rDNA 在所抽样分析中支持圆口类单系。现生序列拓扑不能确定圆口类的化石首现、分歧日期或直接祖先。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The route spans a directly reviewed fossil anchor to living members and is not a crown-origin estimate.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB external identifier withheld: accepted-rank-mismatch.
PBDB lineage is incompatible with the local expected parent Agnatha; external occurrence queries are withheld.

definition.en: A genomics-era synthesis documents living lamprey diversity, life-history variation and comparative genomic resources. It provides a bounded modern taxonomic context, not a fossil range, exact order origin or ancestral life cycle. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 基因组时代的综合记录了现生七鳃鳗多样性、生活史差异和比较基因组资源。它只提供限定的现代分类背景，不是化石延限、精确目级起源或祖先生活史。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The interval connects the undoubted Late Devonian record to living lampreys without asserting continuous sampling.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB external identifier withheld: accepted-rank-mismatch.

definition.en: The Cretaceous hagfish Tethymyxine preserves barbel cartilages, a branchial apparatus behind the skull and chemical traces interpreted as slime glands. These fossil features document similarities to living hagfish, not directly observed slime production or a universal description of every Myxini species. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 白垩纪盲鳗 Tethymyxine 保存了触须软骨、位于头骨后方的鳃器，以及被解释为黏液腺的化学痕迹。这些化石特征记录了与现生盲鳗的相似性，并非直接观察到的黏液分泌，也不代表每个盲鳗物种的通用形态。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Tethymyxine tapirostrum was recovered within crown Myxini; the stem hagfish Myxinikela is not used to extend this crown-group display range.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

names.zh: 七鳃鳗与盲鳗化石档案

definition.en: The Cyclostome fossil evidence route navigation entity is source-linked only to the named specimen, dataset and analysis dossiers already cited by its range ledger. Its displayed span is a study-bounded route or sample envelope, not a biological taxon, ancestor sequence, global FAD/LAD or exact origin interval. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 七鳃鳗与盲鳗化石档案导航实体在此仅链接到延限账本已经引用的具名标本、数据集和分析档案；其显示跨度是研究限定的路线或样本包络，不是生物分类单元、祖先序列、全球首末出现或精确起源区间。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The browse interval spans the represented specimen dossiers while preserving each occurrence, topology and interpretation as a separate evidence record.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB external identifier withheld: not-applicable-navigation-group.

definition.en: The 4.2 cm Priscomyzon riniensis holotype AM5750 is interpreted as a total-group lamprey; the profile does not promote it to crown Petromyzontida or a direct ancestor. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 4.2 厘米长的 Priscomyzon riniensis 正模 AM5750 被解释为七鳃鳗总群；本画像不把它提升为七鳃鳗冠群或直接祖先。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Holotype AM5750 is a single articulated body from the Famennian Witpoort Formation; the envelope represents that sampled occurrence rather than a global species range.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Myxinikela siroka is represented by holotype FMNH PF15373 and paratype FMNH PF8472 and is interpreted as a stem or putative total-group hagfish, not a crown-Myxini member. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Myxinikela siroka 由正模 FMNH PF15373 与副模 FMNH PF8472 代表，被解释为盲鳗干群或可能的总群成员，而非盲鳗纲冠群。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Holotype FMNH PF15373 and paratype FMNH PF8472 document the represented Moscovian sample; the interval is not a crown-hagfish or global lineage range.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Tethymyxine tapirostrum holotype BHI 6445 was recovered within crown Myxini in the published morphology analysis, while its exact branch position remains matrix-dependent. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Tethymyxine tapirostrum 正模 BHI 6445 在已发表形态分析中位于盲鳗纲冠群内部，但具体支系位置仍依赖矩阵。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Complete holotype BHI 6445 was recovered within crown Myxini; the Cenomanian envelope is a sampled fossil bound, not a global origin date.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Qianodus tooth whorls from late Aeronian strata at approximately 439 Ma anchor the 439–0 Ma Gnathostomata route; isolated dental elements provide a minimum sampled occurrence, not the origin of jaws, crown age or global FAD. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 晚 Aeronian 期约 439 Ma 地层中的 Qianodus 齿旋锚定 439–0 Ma 的有颌脊椎动物路线；孤立牙齿材料只提供取样最低出现，不是颌的起源、冠群年代或全球首现。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Twenty-three Qianodus tooth whorls provide direct jawed-vertebrate dental evidence and a stem-chondrichthyan analysis; living descendants extend the route.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB external identifier withheld: accepted-rank-mismatch.

definition.en: The Placodermi historical-grade display uses the approximately 436 Ma Huixingshao Formation Xiushanosteus sample as its evidence-linked older anchor; the 358.9 Ma younger edge remains a rounded composite, and neither endpoint is asserted as a global first or last appearance or a direct-ancestor interval. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 盾皮鱼类历史等级的显示范围以约 4.36 亿年前回星哨组的 Xiushanosteus 样本作为有证据连接的老端锚点；3.589 亿年前的年轻端仍是取整后的综合边界，两个端点都不被表述为全球首现、末现或直系祖先区间。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Xiushanosteus supplies a primary-study early Silurian anchor for the historical placoderm-grade display without asserting a global FAD, LAD or direct ancestor.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: New Dunkleosteus species and an explicit Eubrachythoraci matrix provide a documented sample nested within Arthrodira. The eubrachythoracid sample neither resolves all arthrodires nor sets the order's exact global first or last appearance. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 新的邓氏鱼物种与明确的真胸甲鱼矩阵，提供了节甲鱼目内部的一个有据样本。真胸甲鱼样本既未解决全部节甲鱼关系，也未确定该目精确的全球首末出现。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The interval is confined to the Dunkleosteus-bearing study sample and is not the full Arthrodira range.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB external identifier withheld: accepted-rank-mismatch.

definition.en: A reconstructed Dunkleosteus terrelli skull and linkage model yield explicit estimates of jaw kinematics and bite force. The estimates depend on geometry and muscle assumptions and are not direct observations of behaviour, ecology or a genus-wide body plan. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 重建的 Dunkleosteus terrelli 头骨与连杆模型给出明确的颌运动和咬合力估计。这些估计依赖几何与肌肉假设，不是行为、生态或全属体型的直接观测。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The study sample anchors the genus in the Famennian without claiming exhaustive global endpoints.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Xiushanosteus mirabilis is a placoderm-grade jawed stem gnathostome represented by articulated material; its character mosaic does not establish direct ancestry or resolve historical Placodermi as a natural clade. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Xiushanosteus mirabilis 是由关节相连材料代表的盾皮鱼等级有颌类干群；其镶嵌性状不能确立直接祖先关系，也不能把历史上的盾皮鱼类解析为自然类群。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Holotype IVPP V300001 and referred IVPP V300002–V300021 are articulated Huixingshao Formation specimens. The numeric window only converts the published Telychian horizon to the atlas time scale.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: The Chondrichthyes display begins at the approximately 439 Ma Qianodus tooth-whorl sample as an evidence-linked stem-chondrichthyan anchor and continues to living members at 0 Ma; isolated teeth do not establish a crown-chondrichthyan global first appearance, a complete lineage range or direct ancestry. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 软骨鱼类显示范围以约 4.39 亿年前 Qianodus 牙旋样本作为有证据连接的干群锚点，并延续到 0 Ma 的现生成员；孤立牙齿不能建立冠群软骨鱼的全球首现、完整谱系范围或直系祖先关系。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The late Aeronian Qianodus sample provides a primary-study stem-chondrichthyan display anchor; 0 Ma represents sampled living members, not continuous fossil coverage.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Mitochondrial sequences from 595 sampled species provide a broad explicit estimate of living elasmobranch relationships. The mitochondrial tree does not define the total fossil range, exact crown age or global origin of Elasmobranchii. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 595 个抽样物种的线粒体序列提供了广泛而明确的现生板鳃类关系估计。线粒体树不能限定板鳃类的完整化石延限、精确冠群年龄或全球起源。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The interval is a model-to-present navigation window for modern elasmobranchs, not the fossil range of total-group Elasmobranchii.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB external identifier withheld: accepted-rank-mismatch.

definition.en: A dated occurrence sample was analysed under the paper's Carcharocles megalodon usage to estimate a probabilistic extinction window. The atlas uses Otodus megalodon; the sampled estimate is not an exact global last appearance and does not resolve the nomenclatural choice. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 论文以 Carcharocles megalodon 名称分析具年代的出现记录样本，并估计概率性灭绝窗口。图谱采用 Otodus megalodon；这一抽样估计不是精确全球末现，也不裁决命名选择。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Study-specific OLE estimates from Pimiento and Clements (2014), Results and Figure 1; not the revised estimates of later studies. Nomenclature follows Otodus in the atlas.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Mitogenomes representing all three living chimaeriform families provide a sampled topology and molecular divergence estimates. The living sample and clock model do not directly date total-group Holocephali or establish its fossil endpoints. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 代表现生银鲛目三个科的线粒体基因组，提供了抽样拓扑与分子分歧估计。现生样本和时钟模型不能直接给全头类总群定年，也不能确立其化石端点。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The interval represents the modeled lineage leading to modern holocephalans, not total-group fossil endpoints.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

names.zh: 志留纪齿旋软骨鱼干群

definition.en: Qianodus duplicis is represented by twenty-three isolated tooth whorls and was recovered as a stem chondrichthyan; it is not an articulated crown shark. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Qianodus duplicis 由 23 件孤立齿旋代表，在分析中位于软骨鱼干群；它不是关节连接的冠群鲨类。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Twenty-three isolated tooth whorls occur in the late Aeronian Ozarkodina guizhouensis biozone; the point envelope represents that sample only.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

names.zh: 志留纪皮骨骼软骨鱼干群

definition.en: Fanjingshania renovata is represented by holotype IVPP V27433.1 and more than 1000 isolated dermal elements from the late Aeronian Rongxi Formation at approximately 439 Ma; this source-linked sample is not a clade-wide origin, global FAD/LAD, direct ancestor or exact complete range. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 约 439 Ma 晚埃隆期融溪组的 Fanjingshania renovata 由正模 IVPP V27433.1 和一千余件孤立皮骨骼元件代表；这一带来源链接的样本不表示全群起源、全球首末出现、直系祖先或精确完整延限。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Holotype IVPP V27433.1 and more than one thousand referred dermal elements occur in the late Aeronian Rongxi Formation.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB external identifier withheld: no-exact-name-in-snapshot.

definition.en: Shenacanthus vermiformis is known from the sole near-complete holotype IVPP V300000 and was placed within total-group Chondrichthyes, with exact stem position analysis-sensitive. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Shenacanthus vermiformis 仅由近完整正模 IVPP V300000 所知，在分析中归入软骨鱼总群，具体干群位置受分析影响。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The sole near-complete holotype IVPP V300000 occurs in the approximately 436 Ma Huixingshao Formation; the point is specimen-scoped.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

names.zh: 泥盆纪镶嵌型软骨鱼干群

definition.en: Gladbachus adentatus is represented by the single compressed specimen UMZC 2000.32 and was recovered on the chondrichthyan stem rather than within the living crown. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Gladbachus adentatus 仅由受压标本 UMZC 2000.32 代表，在分析中位于软骨鱼干群而非现生冠群。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: UMZC 2000.32 is the single sampled Upper Givetian specimen; its point envelope is not a global species duration or crown-shark range.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

names.zh: 宽吻泥盆纪对称鳍鲨形软骨鱼

definition.en: Maghriboselache mohamezanei is a new symmoriiform chondrichthyan represented by several partly articulated skeletons, including three-dimensional cranial specimens AA.MEM.DS.12 and PIMUZ A/I 5159; the cited matrix places it with Cladoselache in an early symmoriiform grouping, while alternative analyses can recover symmoriiforms differently. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Maghriboselache mohamezanei 是由数件部分关节相连骨架代表、包括三维脑颅标本 AA.MEM.DS.12 与 PIMUZ A/I 5159 的新对称鳍鲨形软骨鱼；所引矩阵将其与 Cladoselache 置于早期对称鳍鲨形类组合，但其他分析可能得到不同的对称鳍鲨形类位置。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The named Moroccan sample includes several partly articulated skeletons and three-dimensional neurocrania from the Thylacocephalan Layer; the numeric window converts the published Famennian assignment only.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

names.zh: 具鳃盖的密西西比世对称鳍鲨形软骨鱼

definition.en: Cosmoselachus mehlingi is a new symmoriiform chondrichthyan from the Late Mississippian, represented by the partial holotype AMNH FF 20509 and recovered in the cited analysis as a falcatid within Symmoriiformes. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Cosmoselachus mehlingi 是晚密西西比世的新对称鳍鲨形软骨鱼，由部分正模 AMNH FF 20509 代表；所引分析将其恢复为对称鳍鲨形目中的镰鲨科成员。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: AMNH FF 20509 is the single partial holotype from the Fayetteville Shale; the point envelope records that sample and not unsampled occurrences.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: The historical Acanthodii navigation grade begins at the approximately 439 Ma Fanjingshania dermoskeletal sample, which the cited analysis places on the chondrichthyan stem; the 252 Ma younger edge is a rounded legacy composite, not evidence that Acanthodii is monophyletic or that Fanjingshania is a direct ancestor or global first occurrence. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 历史性的棘鱼类导航等级从约 4.39 亿年前 Fanjingshania 皮骨骼样本开始；所引分析把它置于软骨鱼干群。2.52 亿年前的年轻端是取整后的历史综合边界，不能据此认定棘鱼类为单系，也不能把 Fanjingshania 写成直系祖先或全球首现。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Fanjingshania anchors the historical acanthodian-grade display while its cited stem-chondrichthyan placement prevents treating Acanthodii as a monophyletic lineage or the specimen as a direct ancestor.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Eosteus chongqingensis from approximately 436 Ma early Silurian strata anchors the 436–0 Ma Osteichthyes route as the oldest reported articulated bony-fish occurrence; its stem placement is analysis-dependent and is not a crown split or global origination date. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 约 436 Ma 早志留世地层中的 Eosteus chongqingensis 以目前报道最早的关节连接硬骨鱼出现记录锚定 436–0 Ma 路线；其干群位置依赖分析，不能当作冠群分裂或全球起源日期。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The articulated Eosteus specimen and explicit parsimony and Bayesian analyses anchor the oldest reported osteichthyan occurrence, with living lineages extending to the present.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB external identifier withheld: accepted-rank-mismatch.

definition.en: CT scans of named late Eifelian Cheirolepis trailli specimens from the Achanarras Limestone document parts of the braincase, jaw suspension and pectoral-fin endoskeleton, including an imperforate propterygium and peg-and-socket scales; this sampled anatomy is not a complete Actinopterygii body plan or a global first-appearance datum. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: CT 扫描晚艾菲尔期 Achanarras 石灰岩的具名 Cheirolepis trailli 标本，记录了脑颅、悬颌结构和胸鳍内骨骼的部分结构，包括无孔前鳍骨与榫槽式关节鳞片；这组已取样解剖不是辐鳍鱼类的完整身体蓝图，也不是全球首现依据。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: CT-scanned Cheirolepis museum specimens provide a secure primary-study early actinopterygian anchor; 0 Ma represents living ray-finned fishes rather than continuous sampling.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB external identifier withheld: accepted-rank-mismatch.

definition.en: Mitochondrial sequences test relationships among sampled neopterygians and recover a conditional topology with uneven node support. The limited extant sample does not delimit Neopterygii's fossil range, exact origin or direct ancestors. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 线粒体序列检验了所抽样新鳍鱼类之间的关系，并得到节点支持度不均的条件性拓扑。有限的现生样本不能限定新鳍鱼类的化石延限、精确起源或直接祖先。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The display records the reported crown-node interval only and does not imply a continuous sampled fossil record.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: A multilocus, fossil-calibrated ray-finned-fish tree recovers living gars and bowfin together as Holostei. The result supports sampled holostean topology; its node age is model-dependent and not a direct fossil origin date. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 多位点、化石校准的辐鳍鱼树把现生雀鳝与弓鳍鱼共同恢复为全骨类。该结果支持抽样的全骨类拓扑；其节点年龄依赖模型，不是直接的化石起源日期。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The model interval is distinct from fossil minima and the living duration of gars and bowfin.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Gene trees, species-tree analyses and morphology converge on a similar relationship pattern among sampled living gars. The living Lepisosteidae sample does not delimit all fossil Lepisosteiformes or establish an exact order origin. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 基因树、物种树分析和形态数据在所抽样现生雀鳝关系上趋于一致。现生雀鳝科样本不能限定全部化石雀鳝目，也不能确定精确目级起源。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。
