limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Teleoceras is treated as a North American rhinocerotid genus, while the strongest Ashfall conclusions are restricted to T. major. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 短腿犀属按所引系统研究采用当前分类层级；导航父级仅表示分类关联，不表示直接祖先。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The primary isotope study places North American Teleoceras major within the Clarendonian at 12.5–10 Ma and directly dates the sampled Ashfall site to 11.86 ± 0.13 Ma.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Coelodonta is treated as a rhinocerotid genus whose species include ecologically distinct Tibetan, East Asian and northern Eurasian samples. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 披毛犀属按所引系统研究采用当前分类层级；导航父级仅表示分类关联，不表示直接祖先。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: A systematic review identifies Coelodonta thibetana at 5.08 Ma as the earliest known genus record, while a genomic primary study directly dates a Coelodonta antiquitatis individual to 14.4 ka.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: The 56–0 Ma Carnivora route is a total-group evidence anthology: the Dormaal Carnivoraformes sample anchors the older bound and living crown carnivorans extend to the present; it is not a crown-Carnivora FAD or ancestor chain. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 56–0 Ma 的食肉类路线是总群证据选集：Dormaal 的 Carnivoraformes 样本锚定较老端点，现生食肉目冠群延续至今；它不是食肉目冠群首现或祖先链。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Dental and tarsal anatomy from the Dormaal sample anchors a total-group browsing route, while living crown carnivorans extend to the present.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

names.zh: 食肉形类干群档案导航

definition.en: The Carnivoraformes dossier route is an atlas navigation grouping for sampled stem carnivoraform studies; a broad morphology matrix tests those fossils relative to crown Carnivora but does not make the route itself a taxon or ancestor lineage. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Carnivoraformes 专题路线是图谱中汇集取样干群食肉形类研究的导航组合；广泛形态矩阵检验这些化石相对于冠群食肉目的位置，但不使路线本身成为类群或祖先谱系。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: A source audit of Phylogeny of the Carnivoramorpha: The impact of postcranial characters found relationship or taxonomic evidence but no range-fit support for the former numerical display.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB external identifier withheld: no-exact-name-in-snapshot.

definition.en: The Dormaal sample supports Dormaalocyon latouri and a basal carnivoraform placement in the published matrix; it is not promoted into crown Carnivora or direct ancestry. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Dormaal 样本支持 Dormaalocyon latouri 及其在已发表矩阵中的基部食肉形类位置；本资料不把它提升为食肉目冠群成员或直接祖先。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: IRSNB M2095–M2099 document reconstructed permanent dentition, while astragali IRSNB M2107–M2108 and calcaneum IRSNB M2109 document the tarsus.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: An early-miaced cladistic analysis samples Vulpavus and supports limited relationships among named genera while leaving broader “Miacidae” structure poorly resolved; Vulpavus is therefore a sampled fossil branch, not a direct carnivoran ancestor. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 一项早期“细齿兽类”支序分析取样 Vulpavus，并支持若干具名属间的有限关系，同时使广义“Miacidae”结构仍解析不足；因此 Vulpavus 是取样化石分支，而非食肉类直接祖先。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: A source audit of Referral of Miacis jepseni Guthrie to Oödectes Wortman, and an assessment of phylogenetic relationships among early Eocene Miacidae (Mammalia: Carnivora) found relationship or taxonomic evidence but no range-fit support for the former numerical display.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: The same morphology analysis samples Uintacyon and recovers a limited Uintacyon–Vassacyon relationship while emphasizing weak resolution among early “miacids”; the result does not identify Uintacyon as a crown carnivoran ancestor. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 同一形态分析取样 Uintacyon，并恢复有限的 Uintacyon—Vassacyon 关系，同时强调早期“细齿兽类”之间解析度低；该结果不把 Uintacyon 认定为冠群食肉类祖先。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: A source audit of Referral of Miacis jepseni Guthrie to Oödectes Wortman, and an assessment of phylogenetic relationships among early Eocene Miacidae (Mammalia: Carnivora) found relationship or taxonomic evidence but no range-fit support for the former numerical display.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Tomiya's Paleogene-only morphology subset recovers Lycophocyon hutchisoni on the caniform branch outside crown Canoidea, whereas the broader analysis does not resolve its nearby carnivoramorphan relationships. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Tomiya 的古近纪限定形态子集将 Lycophocyon hutchisoni 恢复在犬型类支系、犬总科冠群之外，而更广泛的分析未能解析其邻近的食肉形类关系。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Holotype UCMP 85202 supplies the cranium and dentition; associated paratypes SDSNH 107446 and SDSNH 107447 add postcranial anatomy.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: A species-level supertree assembled from 188 source trees recovers Feliformia among extant Carnivora and resolves its sampled families, while several internal relationships differ from earlier trees; it does not supply a fossil first appearance. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 一棵由 188 棵来源树组装的物种级超级树在现生食肉目中恢复猫型亚目并解析其取样科，但若干内部关系不同于早期树；它不提供化石首现。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: A source audit of Updating the evolutionary history of Carnivora (Mammalia): a new species-level supertree complete with divergence time estimates found relationship or taxonomic evidence but no range-fit support for the former numerical display.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Felidae forms a sampled family branch in the extant-carnivoran supertree, with its higher feliform relationship revised relative to the earlier supertree; this evidence does not include extinct felid diversity comprehensively or define the family’s origin time. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 猫科在现生食肉类超级树中形成一个取样科级分支，其猫型类高阶关系相对早期超级树有所修订；该证据未全面包含灭绝猫科多样性，也不定义科级起源时间。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: A source audit of Updating the evolutionary history of Carnivora (Mammalia): a new species-level supertree complete with divergence time estimates found relationship or taxonomic evidence but no range-fit support for the former numerical display.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: A partial mitochondrial genome from one Smilodon populator specimen places the sampled lineage with Homotherium in a well-supported machairodont clade within Felidae, distinct from sampled living felid lineages; one Smilodon sample and mitochondrial inheritance limit broader species-level inference. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 一件 Smilodon populator 标本的部分线粒体基因组，把该取样谱系与 Homotherium 一同置于猫科内部支持良好、区别于取样现生猫科各支的剑齿虎类分支；仅一件 Smilodon 样本且证据来自线粒体，限制了更广泛的物种级推断。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Evolutionary History of Saber-Toothed Cats Based on Ancient Mitogenomics directly anchors the sampled window; the display does not extrapolate it into a global taxon duration.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: The original study assigned IVPP V18788.1–3 to Panthera blytheae in a combined analysis; generic assignment and snow-leopard affinity are revisable rather than ancestral facts. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 原研究在综合分析中把 IVPP V18788.1–3 归为 Panthera blytheae；属级归属和雪豹亲缘关系均可修订，而非祖先事实。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Holotype IVPP V18788.1 is an adult partial cranium; IVPP V18788.2 is a ramus fragment and IVPP V18788.3 a partial premaxilla. The locality sample spans 5.95–4.10 Ma in the original magnetostratigraphic framework.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: A carnivoran supertree recovers Caniformia and its sampled living family branches. Its topology and divergence estimates combine source trees, newly inferred gene trees and fossil calibrations, so they are analytical results built from several evidence layers rather than direct fossil observations. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 食肉类超级树恢复了犬型亚目及其取样的现生科级分支。树的拓扑与分化估计结合来源树、新推断基因树和化石校准；这些是基于多层证据的分析结果，并非直接化石观测。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: A source audit of Updating the evolutionary history of Carnivora (Mammalia): a new species-level supertree complete with divergence time estimates found relationship or taxonomic evidence but no range-fit support for the former numerical display.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: In the cited living-carnivoran supertree, Canidae is recovered as a family branch and its subtree samples dog-like and fox-like lineages. The analysis does not include extinct canid radiations or determine the family’s earliest fossil range. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 所引现生食肉类超级树把犬科恢复为一个科级分支，其犬科子树取样了犬样与狐样谱系。该分析没有纳入灭绝犬科辐射，也未确定犬科最早化石范围。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: A source audit of Updating the evolutionary history of Carnivora (Mammalia): a new species-level supertree complete with divergence time estimates found relationship or taxonomic evidence but no range-fit support for the former numerical display.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Wang's monographic revision treats Hesperocyon as part of the extinct Hesperocyoninae canid sample and tests species-level relationships from scored morphology; the sampled genus is not asserted to be a direct ancestor of later canids. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Wang 的专著修订将 Hesperocyon 作为灭绝黄昏犬亚科犬类样本的一部分，并用评分形态检验种级关系；该取样属并未被断言为后期犬类的直系祖先。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Phylogenetic systematics of the Hesperocyoninae (Carnivora: Canidae) directly anchors the sampled window; the display does not extrapolate it into a global taxon duration.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Expanded early-amphicyonid morphology sampling recovers Amphicyonidae as a basal caniform branch outside Canoidea, while exact sister relationships remain unresolved; the family is not a dog–bear ancestor blend or one linear lineage. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 扩展的早期 Amphicyonidae 形态取样把该科恢复为 Canoidea 之外的基干犬型类分支，但精确姐妹关系仍未解决；该科不是犬—熊祖先混合体，也不是单一线性谱系。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Whence the beardogs? Reappraisal of the Middle to Late Eocene “Miacis” from Texas, USA, and the origin of Amphicyonidae directly anchors the sampled window; the display does not extrapolate it into a global taxon duration.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB external identifier withheld: accepted-rank-mismatch.

definition.en: *Gustafsonia cognita* is anchored by holotype cranium TMM 40209-200 from the Chambers Tuff. CT reconstruction and the study’s analysis place this material within an approximately 38–36.6 Ma sample envelope. That is not a global first appearance for the family or a date of direct ancestry. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: *Gustafsonia cognita* 以 Chambers Tuff 的正模头骨 TMM 40209-200 为依据。CT 重建与该研究的分析把材料置于约 3800 万—3660 万年前的样本区间。这不是该科的全球首现，也不是直接祖先日期。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The holotype cranium of Gustafsonia cognita, TMM 40209-200, was CT-reconstructed; Angelarctocyon australis is represented by TMM 41850-1 and referred jaw material.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Angelarctocyon australis is bounded by holotype TMM 41850-1 and referred jaw material from the Chambers Tuff within an approximately 42–38 Ma sample envelope; this is not a global genus duration or direct ancestor interval. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Angelarctocyon australis 由 Chambers Tuff 的正模 TMM 41850-1 与归入颌骨材料约束，处于约 4200 万—3800 万年前的样本区间；这不是全球属级延续或直接祖先区间。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The holotype cranium of Gustafsonia cognita, TMM 40209-200, was CT-reconstructed; Angelarctocyon australis is represented by TMM 41850-1 and referred jaw material.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: The *Magericyon anceps* material from Batallones-1 includes the complete young-adult skull B-4071. The locality sample is dated to about 9.7–8.7 Ma. This interval anchors the studied specimen and place; it is not a global duration for the genus. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Batallones-1 的 *Magericyon anceps* 材料包括完整的青年成体头骨 B-4071。该地点样本约为 970 万—870 万年前。这个区间限定所研究的标本与地点，不代表该属的全球延续时间。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Holotype B-4071 is a complete young-adult skull; the 2026 analysis compares intrinsic canine, p4 and m1 bites and extrinsic pull-back and head-shaking loads, with meshes and scripts deposited on Zenodo.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: The cited extant-carnivoran supertree recovers Ursidae as one living family branch. Its family-level relationships and crown dates are estimates assembled from gene trees and calibrations, and extinct stem bears are not comprehensively sampled. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 所引现生食肉类超级树把熊科恢复为一个现生科级分支。科级关系与冠群年代是由基因树和校准资料组装的估计，灭绝干群熊类也未被全面取样。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: A source audit of Updating the evolutionary history of Carnivora (Mammalia): a new species-level supertree complete with divergence time estimates found relationship or taxonomic evidence but no range-fit support for the former numerical display.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: A published fossil-plus-living ursid morphology matrix recovers Kretzoiarctos within Ailuropodinae, but internal ailuropodine clades are unresolved in its majority-rule bootstrap tree. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 已发表的化石加现生熊科形态矩阵将 Kretzoiarctos 恢复在大熊猫亚科内，但多数规则自助法树未能解析大熊猫亚科内部支系。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Holotype MNCN-CSIC NV-2-42 is a left P4; NV-2-40 is a right M1, and IPS 46473 is a partial mandible with c1–m2 and associated P4.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: The atlas route joins fossil pinniped-line evidence to the living seal, sea-lion and walrus branches sampled in the carnivoran supertree. That extant tree does not resolve all stem pinnipeds or establish the group’s first appearance; its living topology should not be read as a complete fossil history. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 图谱路线把化石鳍足型类证据与食肉类超级树取样的现生海豹、海狮和海象分支联系起来。现生树没有解析所有干群鳍足类，也未确定该类群的首现；不能把现生拓扑读作完整化石历史。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: A source audit of Updating the evolutionary history of Carnivora (Mammalia): a new species-level supertree complete with divergence time estimates found relationship or taxonomic evidence but no range-fit support for the former numerical display.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: NUFV 405 was placed within Pinnipedimorpha by the source matrix; the result does not make Puijila a direct ancestor of seals. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 来源矩阵将 NUFV 405 置于鳍足形类；这一结果不使 Puijila 成为海豹的直接祖先。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Holotype NUFV 405 preserves roughly 65% of one skeleton, including skull, dentition, vertebrae and substantial fore- and hind limbs from an early Miocene lake deposit.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Berta and Ray describe LACM 4321 as Enaliarctos mealsi and test pinniped relationships from its skeletal anatomy; their sampled topology is not a direct-ancestor assertion or a universal pinniped phylogeny. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Berta 与 Ray 将 LACM 4321 描述为 Enaliarctos mealsi，并以其骨骼解剖检验鳍足类关系；该研究的取样拓扑不是直系祖先断言，也不是普遍的鳍足类系统树。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The primary report places the nearly complete LACM 4321 skeleton at approximately 23 Ma; the detailed study describes its virtually complete anatomy and bounded locomotor comparisons.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: The Chiroptera route is anchored by the Green River holotype of *Onychonycteris* (ROM 55351A) together with living bats. The specimen documents an early bat occurrence; it does not date crown-bat origin, establish a direct ancestor or provide a global first-appearance datum. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Chiroptera 路线以绿河组 *Onychonycteris* 正模（ROM 55351A）和现生蝙蝠共同锚定。该标本记录了一次早期蝙蝠出现；它不能测定蝙蝠冠群起源、证明直接祖先关系，也不是全球首现数据。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Onychonycteris holotype ROM 55351A anchors an early bat occurrence and living bats extend the route to the present.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: ROM 55351A defines Onychonycteris finneyi and was placed near the bat stem in the source matrix; this is not a direct ancestor claim. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: ROM 55351A 确立了 Onychonycteris finneyi，并在来源矩阵中被置于蝙蝠干群附近；这不是直接祖先主张。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: ROM 55351A is the nearly complete holotype from the early Eocene Fossil Butte Member.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: The Whippomorpha route combines two different records: an approximately 48.6 Ma *Indohyus* sample from Sindkhatudi, with morphology and isotope evidence, and retroposon evidence for relationships among living whales and hippos. The rounded 55 Ma ceiling is a navigation bound; neither source dates the Whippomorpha crown or a continuous lineage duration. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Whippomorpha 路线组合了两种不同证据：Sindkhatudi 约 4860 万年前的 *Indohyus* 样本及其形态、同位素资料，以及用于判断现生鲸与河马关系的逆转座子证据。取整后的 5500 万年上限是导航边界；两项来源都没有测定 Whippomorpha 冠群年代或连续谱系延续时间。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Indohyus morphology and isotope evidence at approximately 48.6 Ma plus living retroposon topology form an evidence anthology; the older display ceiling preserves nested early-cetacean navigation.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: A systematic review and 37-character cladistic analysis sampled 15 living and fossil hippopotamid taxa and revised several historical assignments. Hippopotamidae is the study’s focal family, but the resulting membership is a sampled taxonomic hypothesis, not a complete fossil duration. definition.en: A placental analysis of 16,397 base pairs recovered Afrotheria in its sampled topology and estimated a split at about 103 Ma under the study’s models. The atlas rounds this to a 100 Ma navigation ceiling and carries the route to the present through living descendants. The estimate is model context, not a fossil occurrence, an exact crown-group origin, or evidence that the ancestor lived in Africa. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.

definition.en: COL26.8 records accepted checklist placement; historical archive names and matching rules remain source-specific and do not define current species concepts. The assigned numerical range record is withheld: historical trait values and a mammal-wide tree of sampled living elephant lineages do not establish a fossil range for extinct proboscideans or date the order’s origin. These route entries also do not establish complete distribution, conservation status, or traits shared by every descendant. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: COL26.8 记录清单中的接受分类位置；各历史档案的名称和匹配规则仍限于其来源，不能据此确定当前物种概念。本节点的数值范围记录处于撤回状态：历史性状数据和取样现生象类的哺乳动物全局系统树不能确定已灭绝长鼻类的化石范围，也不能测定该目的起源。这里的路线记录也不确定完整分布、保护状况或所有后代共有的特征。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: A source audit of Inferring the mammal tree: Species-level sets of phylogenies for questions in ecology, evolution, and conservation found relationship or taxonomic evidence but no range-fit support for the former numerical display.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Palkopoulou et al. (2018) compared sampled mammoths with living elephants and mastodon. Their genome-scale analyses support a reticulate elephantid history involving introgression and incomplete lineage sorting. The sampled genomes describe those lineages and relationships; they do not set Mammuthus’ full fossil duration or establish one simple bifurcating ancestor tree. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Palkopoulou 等（2018）比较了取样猛犸、现生象与乳齿象。其基因组尺度分析支持包含基因渗入与不完全谱系排序的网状象科历史。取样基因组描述的是这些谱系及其关系，不确定 Mammuthus 的完整化石延续，也不建立单一的二叉祖先树。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: A comprehensive genomic history of extinct and living elephants directly anchors the sampled window; the display does not extrapolate it into a global taxon duration.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: MNHN PM69 and fourteen referred specimens define Eritherium azzouzorum; the source's stem-proboscidean placement is a character-matrix result, not a direct ancestry claim. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: MNHN PM69 和十四件归入标本构成 Eritherium azzouzorum 的定义材料；来源研究将其定位于长鼻类干群，是性状矩阵的分析结果，而非直接祖先关系的断言。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: MNHN PM69 and the 15-specimen hypodigm come from the early Thanetian interval described by the study.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: The atlas displays a 58.3–0 Ma Xenarthra navigation route based on O’Leary et al.’s combined phenomic–molecular chronology. Its older edge follows the model’s Riostegotherium entry and ghost-lineage treatment; living xenarthrans extend the route to the present. This is a sampled, model-conditioned bound, not a securely dated global first fossil or crown origin. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 图集依据 O’Leary 等的表型—分子联合年代框架，显示 58.3–0 Ma 的 Xenarthra 导航路线。较老端点沿用模型中的 Riostegotherium 条目和幽灵谱系处理；现生异关节类将路线延伸至今。这是受取样与模型条件限定的边界，不是可靠测定的全球最早化石或冠群起源。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The combined-data chronology supplies a transparent sampled/model bound while living Xenarthra extend the route to the present.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Amson et al. compared bone compactness across five named Thalassocnus species sampled from successive horizons in Peru’s Pisco Formation, spanning an approximately 8–3 Ma study window. The series supports comparison of bone-density change across those samples. Functional adaptation and continuity of one lineage are interpretations; the sample window is not a global genus duration or a direct-ancestor sequence. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Amson 等比较了来自秘鲁 Pisco 组连续层位的五个具名 Thalassocnus 物种骨组织致密度，研究样本约跨 800 万—300 万年前。该系列可用于比较这些样本之间的骨密度变化。功能适应和单一谱系连续性仍属解释；样本窗口不是属的全球存续期，也不是直接祖先序列。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Five named species occur in successive Pisco Formation horizons used for the compactness comparison.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: The 66–0 Ma Glires route uses a rounded K–Pg model/display ceiling, contextualized by a post-K–Pg placental analysis, and a separate direct Mimolagus fossil sample dated to 47.8–41.2 Ma in China’s Erlian Basin. Living descendants carry the navigation route to the present. The model ceiling is not a fossil first appearance; the Mimolagus interval dates that sample, not crown Glires. Neither source shows continuous fossil occupancy. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Glires 的 66–0 Ma 路线采用取整的 K–Pg 模型／显示上限，并以一项 K–Pg 后胎盘类分析作为背景；另有中国二连盆地 Mimolagus 化石样本，年代为 47.8–41.2 Ma。现生后裔将导航路线延伸至今。模型上限不是化石首现；Mimolagus 区间测定的是该样本，不是啮形类冠群。两项来源都没有显示连续化石占据。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: A post-K–Pg placental chronology contextualizes the display ceiling and the Mimolagus sample supplies a bounded fossil occurrence without asserting continuous occupancy.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: COL26.8 records Rodentia as an accepted order. In the mammal-wide 31-gene study, the higher branch is constrained and some DNA-missing taxa inherit explicit placements; this is not sequence evidence for every rodent or a fossil-origin date. The separate historical archives use their own names, fields, and selection rules. None of these partial routes establishes This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: COL26.8 将 Rodentia 记录为接受目级分类。在哺乳动物全局 31 基因研究中，高阶分支受到约束，部分缺少 DNA 的类群沿用明确分类位置；这不是每种啮齿类的序列证据，也不是化石起源日期。各历史档案使用各自名称、字段和筛选规则。任何一条不完整路线都不能确定当前物种概念、完整分布、保护状况或全目共有特征。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: A source audit of Inferring the mammal tree: Species-level sets of phylogenies for questions in ecology, evolution, and conservation found relationship or taxonomic evidence but no range-fit support for the former numerical display.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Right M3 IVPP V20115 and referred material are assigned to Mimolagus aurorae in the published comparison; mimotonid and lagomorph affinities are matrix- and character-dependent, not direct ancestry. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 已发表的比较研究将右侧第三臼齿 IVPP V20115 及归入材料归为 Mimolagus aurorae；其与拟兔类和兔形类的亲缘关系取决于矩阵及性状分析，并非直接祖先关系。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: IVPP V20115 and referred specimens are reported from the early Middle Eocene lower Irdin Manha Formation.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: This atlas route brings together separate studies of Juramaia, Eomaia, and Ambolestes to compare evidence relevant to early therians. Their selected records span about 161–124.1 Ma. That interval belongs to the navigation route, not a taxonomic clade, continuous lineage, or sequence of direct ancestors. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 这条图谱路线汇集 Juramaia、Eomaia 和 Ambolestes 的不同研究，用于对读早期兽类相关证据。所选记录约跨 1.61 亿—1.241 亿年前。该区间属于导航路线，不代表分类支系、连续谱系或直接祖先序列。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The browse interval spans three separately sampled fossils and does not arrange them into an ancestor sequence.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB external identifier withheld: no-exact-name-in-snapshot.

definition.en: Luo et al. (2011) attributed holotype BMNH PM1343B to the Tiaojishan Formation of Liaoning, China, at approximately 161–159 Ma. The collection provenance is uncertain, and a later tip-dating analysis reports a younger signal under its model. The interval is therefore a contested, source-bounded attribution, not a secure global first appearance or calibration point. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Luo 等（2011）将正模 BMNH PM1343B 归入中国辽宁髫髻山组，年代约为 161–159 Ma。采集产地来源仍不确定，后续尖端定年分析在其模型下给出较年轻的信号。因此，该区间是存在争议、受来源限定的归属，不是可靠的全球首现或校准点。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: BMNH PM1343B is reported from approximately 160 Ma strata, but the atlas retains provenance and model-age caveats.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: CAGS 01-IG-1a,b was recovered as basal Eutheria in the original matrix, while later combined analyses can move Eomaia outside Theria; neither result is ancestry. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: CAGS 01-IG-1a,b 在原始矩阵中被恢复为真兽类基部成员，而后来的综合分析可将 Eomaia 移至兽亚纲之外；两种结果都不表示祖先关系。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: CAGS 01-IG-1a,b is the articulated skeleton reported from the Yixian Formation.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Bi et al. (2018) described near-complete holotype STM33-5 from the Lujiatun Unit of the Yixian Formation in Liaoning, China, within an approximately 126–125 Ma interval. Their phylogenetic analysis places Ambolestes among eutherians, but that higher placement depends on the character matrix. The specimen interval is not a secure global genus range, and the placement does not make it a direct placental ancestor. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Bi 等（2018）描述了来自中国辽宁义县组陆家屯层的近完整正模 STM33-5，年代约为 126–125 Ma。其系统发育分析将 Ambolestes 置于真兽类中，但这一高阶位置依赖所用特征矩阵。标本年代区间不是可靠的属级全球范围，该分类位置也不意味着它是胎盘类的直接祖先。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: STM33-5 is the near-complete holotype reported from the Lujiatun Unit.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: IVPP V15424 defines Raranimus dashankouensis and was recovered immediately outside the other sampled therapsids in one 71-character analysis; this profile does not present it as a direct ancestor. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: IVPP V15424 确立了 Raranimus dashankouensis；在一项含 71 个性状的分析中，它被恢复在其余取样兽孔类的紧邻外侧。本资料不把它表述为直接祖先。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Named specimen material and its explicitly bounded stratigraphic context in the cited primary study.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: The 358.9–0 Ma Sauropsida route uses the Snowy Plains clawed trackway as a probable primitive-sauropsid minimum; because the trackmaker could lie near the amniote crown node, the endpoint is contested and not a body-fossil FAD or crown-birth date. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 358.9–0 Ma 的蜥形类路线把 Snowy Plains 具爪足迹作为可能的原始蜥形类最低记录；由于足迹制造者也可能接近羊膜动物冠群节点，该端点仍有争议，且不是身体化石首现或冠群诞生日期。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Clawed manus–pes morphology supports the probable sauropsid interpretation while the published alternative prevents a secure body-fossil or crown-origin claim.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB external identifier withheld: accepted-rank-mismatch.

definition.en: Li et al. place Odontochelys basal to the known fossil and living turtles in their analysis, while the broader Mesozoic turtle matrix of Joyce samples 45 fossil and 22 living species; this profile retains Testudines as a navigation route rather than a single resolved stem-to-crown topology. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Li 等的分析将 Odontochelys 置于当时已知化石及现生龟类的基部，而 Joyce 范围更广的中生代龟类矩阵采样了 45 个化石种和 22 个现生种；本档案保留 Testudines 作为导航入口，而非一套已完全解析的干群至冠群拓扑。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Three named Odontochelys specimens anchor the atlas turtle-line display while stem placement, shell assembly and ancestry remain explicit interpretations.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: The Cryptodira route represents the sampled crown-side turtle clade in Joyce’s morphology matrix; relationships within Cryptodira are partly unresolved, and the analysis does not supply an exact crown origin or global first appearance. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 隐颈龟类路线表示 Joyce 形态矩阵中取样的龟类冠群一侧支系；隐颈龟内部部分关系仍未解决，该分析并未给出精确的冠群起源或全球首现。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The former display is withheld rather than borrowing a Testudines calibration.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: The Pleurodira display route borrows the 155.6 Ma Caribemys-based hard minimum for crown Testudines as a conservative navigation boundary; that calibration is not a Pleurodira origin date, direct ancestor or audited global first appearance. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 侧颈龟类显示路线借用基于 Caribemys 的 1.556 亿年前冠群龟类硬下限作为保守导航边界；该校准不是侧颈龟类的起源日期、直接祖先或经审计的全球首现。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The former Pleurodira display is withheld rather than reusing a different node’s calibration.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: The Ichthyosauria navigation envelope starts at the approximately 248 Ma Chaohusaurus specimen from the Procolumbites Zone and retains 90 Ma as a rounded younger composite; the sampled occurrence is not an exact global first appearance, complete lineage duration or direct ancestor. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 鱼龙类导航范围从约 2.48 亿年前 Procolumbites 带的 Chaohusaurus 标本开始，并保留 0.90 亿年前作为取整的年轻端综合边界；该样本记录不是精确全球首现、完整谱系时长或直系祖先。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The named Chaohusaurus maternal specimen and Procolumbites Zone context provide a primary-study Early Triassic anchor without asserting a global FAD, complete duration or direct ancestor.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.
PBDB external identifier withheld: accepted-rank-mismatch.

definition.en: Ichthyosaurus is a Lower Jurassic ichthyosaur genus whose Hettangian Somerset material supports diagnosable species and explicit phylogenetic tests. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Ichthyosaurus 是早侏罗世鱼龙属，来自萨默塞特赫唐期的材料支持可诊断物种与显式系统发育检验。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The global display remains a composite; Lomax and Massare provide a primary-study Hettangian regional range and species sample.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Cartorhynchus is anchored here only by holotype AGM I-1 from the Lower Triassic Nanlinghu Formation; that named specimen and horizon do not define the genus-wide first or last appearance or an ichthyosauriform origin. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 本图集中的短吻鱼龙仅由下三叠统南陵湖组正模 AGM I-1 锚定；该具名标本和层位不定义属级首末现，也不代表鱼龙形类起源。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Named holotype AGM I-1 and its Lower Triassic stratigraphic placement in the primary description.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Chaohusaurus is assigned to the Early Triassic ichthyopterygians in Motani et al.'s study using delayed ossification of carpals and tarsals, dental morphology, vertebral count and hypophalangeal flippers; species-level taxonomy may require revision as more specimens are prepared. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Motani 等依据腕骨和跗骨相对掌骨、跖骨及趾骨的延迟骨化、牙齿形态、椎骨数和下指骨鳍肢，将 Chaohusaurus 归入早三叠世鱼龙纲类群；随着更多标本制备，种级分类或需修订。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: AGM I-1 comes from the Procolumbites Zone documented in the specimen and locality sections of the primary paper.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Stenopterygius is represented by specimen MH 432 from the Posidonia Shale at Holzmaden; this specimen-level occurrence is not a complete genus duration or a global first or last appearance. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 狭翼鱼龙由霍尔茨马登波西多尼亚页岩的 MH 432 标本表示；这一标本级记录不是完整属级时长，也不是全球首现或末现。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Named specimen MH 432 is explicitly tied to the Posidonia Shale and Holzmaden in the primary study.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Plesiosauria is represented securely in the Rhaetian by the diagnostic articulated Rhaeticosaurus skeleton; older Bobosaurus remains an uncertain near-plesiosaur candidate rather than accepted diagnostic Plesiosauria. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 诊断性关节骨架 Rhaeticosaurus 可靠记录蛇颈龙类已出现于瑞替期；更老的 Bobosaurus 仍是不确定近蛇颈龙候选，不被视为已确认蛇颈龙类。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Diagnostic Rhaetian Rhaeticosaurus constrains the older display bound; older Bobosaurus remains an uncertain candidate and does not pull the range into the Carnian.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Elasmosauridae is represented by the taxa sampled in O’Gorman’s revised matrix and paleobiogeographic analysis; the recovered topology and recognized Cenomanian/Santonian intervals are study results, not exact family-wide origin or extinction boundaries. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 薄板龙科表示 O’Gorman 修订矩阵和古生物地理分析中取样的类群；恢复的拓扑及识别出的森诺曼期/桑托期区间是研究结果，不是全科精确起源或灭绝边界。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The interval is specimen- and study-scoped, not the complete Elasmosauridae range.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Rhaeticosaurus mertensi is a new small-bodied plesiosaurian recovered within Plesiosauria as a basal Pliosauridae member in the published 35-taxon, 270-character analysis; that placement is matrix-dependent rather than direct ancestry. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Rhaeticosaurus mertensi 是新命名的小型蛇颈龙类；已发表的 35 个分类单元、270 个性状分析将其恢复为蛇颈龙目中的基干上龙科成员，但该位置依赖矩阵而非直接祖先关系。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Holotype LWL-MFN P 64047 is documented from a specific Exter Formation bed in the locality and stratigraphy section.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Polycotylus is represented by gravid specimen LACM 129639 from the Late Cretaceous Pierre Shale at approximately 78 Ma; it is a local specimen boundary, not a genus-wide first or last appearance. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 双臼椎龙由约 7800 万年前晚白垩世皮埃尔页岩的怀孕标本 LACM 129639 表示；这是局部标本边界，不是属级首现或末现。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The primary description records LACM 129639 from the Late Cretaceous Pierre Shale and gives an approximate age near 78 Ma.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: The cited analyses place Megachirella on the squamate stem, Taytalura as an early-diverging stem lepidosauromorph, and Bellairsia on the squamate stem; these placements are sampled analytical results and do not resolve every lepidosaur relationship. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 所引分析将 Megachirella 置于有鳞类干群，将 Taytalura 视为早期分化的干群鳞龙形类，并将 Bellairsia 置于有鳞类干群；这些定位是基于采样的分析结果，并未解析所有鳞龙类的亲缘关系。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: CT-resolved Megachirella and combined-evidence analyses provide a primary-study anchor for the lepidosaur navigation envelope; 0 Ma reflects living members.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Rhynchocephalia is represented as a formerly diverse sampled radiation with Sphenodon as its sole living lineage; quantitative disparity results do not make the tuatara an unchanged ancestor or a proxy for every fossil member. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 喙头目在此表示为一个曾经多样化的取样辐射，现仅剩楔齿蜥支系；定量形态差异结果并不把楔齿蜥视为不变祖先或所有化石成员的替身。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The route spans sampled fossils to living Sphenodon while rejecting the unchanged living-fossil narrative.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Pan-Squamata is a navigation route spanning sampled stem and crown squamates; the Megachirella analysis recovers one fossil on the squamate stem but does not identify a direct ancestor, crown FAD or complete route duration. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.

temporalRange.basis: The route joins one stem sample to living members without calling the specimen a direct ancestor or crown FAD.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: The Squamata route follows a molecular supermatrix classification of 4,161 sampled living lizard and snake species; it is an extant topology hypothesis and does not establish a fossil first appearance, ancestral species or exact divergence date. definition.en: The Titanosauria material here is the Patagotitan specimen set and its placement in a sampled sauropod matrix. This evidence concerns the sampled taxon, not a complete Titanosauria range, origin, or ancestor chain. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 这里用于代表 Titanosauria 的材料是 Patagotitan 标本集合及其在取样蜥脚类矩阵中的位置。研究以该分类单元开展体重分析；标本和地质年代是直接证据，更广的体重演化与位置解释则取决于比较模型和取样。该证据限定于取样分类单元，不构成 Titanosauria 的完整年代范围、起源或祖先链。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

definition.en: The ontogenetic study uses hatchling, yearling and adult specimens from a Patagonian Mussaurus sample. These materials define the study’s sampled growth series, not the genus’s complete fossil range or three successive evolutionary forms. Its stance reconstruction is a model and should be read as an interpretation of this sample. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.

definition.en: The study anchors Ledumahadi to partial postcranial holotype BP/1/7120 from South Africa’s earliest Jurassic Elliot Formation. The fossil identifies a specimen and geological context. It does not define the genus’s global range, date the origin of quadrupedal sauropodomorphs, or by itself establish a body-mass or posture interpretation. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.

definition.en: Brusatte et al.’s 2010 review synthesizes sampled tyrannosaurid anatomy, growth and biomechanics. It cautions against treating Tyrannosaurus as a proxy for every member. Behavior and family-wide generalization remain inferences bounded by the reviewed sample; the synthesis does not set exact global range endpoints. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Brusatte 等人 2010 年综述综合了取样的暴龙科解剖、生长和生物力学资料。综述提醒读者不要把霸王龙当作每个成员的替身。行为与科级概括仍是受该综述样本限制的推断；这项综合不设定精确的全球年代端点。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

definition.en: A multi-institution growth series documents substantial ontogenetic cranial variation within referred Tyrannosaurus rex specimens, but ontogenetic assignment and synonymy remain analytical decisions rather than directly observed life histories. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.

definition.en: Hone and Holtz revise named and fragmentary spinosaurid material, distinguishing diagnostic fossils from weaker referrals. Their subfamily placements and ecological signals are evidence-weighted hypotheses. The review does not make every member uniformly semiaquatic or establish a complete family range. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Hone 与 Holtz 修订了具名和破碎的棘龙类材料，并区分具有诊断依据的化石与依据较弱的归入。亚科位置和生态信号是按证据权重提出的假说。该综述没有把所有成员描述为具有一致的半水生生态，也没有确立完整的科级年代范围。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

definition.en: Spinosaurus aegyptiacus specimen FSAC-KK 11888 preserves a deep, flexible tail. Researchers tested physical models of that tail for aquatic propulsion, and the experiment supports a hypothesis about swimming performance. The result concerns a fossil structure under model conditions; it is not an observation of a living Spinosaurus swimming. Soft tissue, full-body dynamics and behavior still require reconstruction, so the experiment does not establish one ecology for the genus. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 埃及棘龙标本 FSAC-KK 11888 保存了深而灵活的尾部。研究者用该尾部的实体模型测试水中推进，实验结果支持一种关于游泳表现的假说。结果针对模型条件下的化石结构，并非观察活体棘龙游泳。软组织、全身动力学和行为仍需重建，因此该实验不能证明整个属具有单一生态。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

definition.en: IGM 100/981 preserves regularly spaced bony papillae on its ulna, interpreted as quill knobs. They support secondary feathers attached to that forearm. They do not establish powered flight or full-body plumage, and one specimen cannot establish feathering across every species in the genus. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: IGM 100/981 的尺骨保存规则排列的骨质乳突，被解释为羽茎瘤。这些结构支持该前臂附着次级飞羽，但不能证明动力飞行或全身羽被；一件标本也不能证明属内每个物种都有羽毛。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

definition.en: This Aves route pairs a rounded 150 Ma fossil anchor from referred Archaeopteryx material in the Late Jurassic Bavarian lithographic limestones with living birds at the present. Archaeopteryx is outside crown Neornithes, so this is a browsing anthology, not a continuous ancestor chain or a date for the origin of crown birds. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 这条 Aves 路线把约 150 Ma 的晚侏罗世巴伐利亚板状石灰岩中归入 Archaeopteryx 的材料，与现生鸟类端点并列。Archaeopteryx 位于现生鸟冠群 Neornithes 之外，因此这是一条浏览选集，不是连续的祖先链，也不标示冠群鸟类的起源时间。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Referred Archaeopteryx material provides the fossil anchor while living birds supply the present endpoint; the two are an explicit browse anthology.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Archaeopteryx is a Late Jurassic avialan outside crown Neornithes; substantial anatomical variation among referred specimens does not make it the direct ancestor of living birds. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Archaeopteryx 是位于冠群今鸟类之外的晚侏罗世鸟翼类；归入标本间的显著解剖变异也不使它成为现生鸟类的直系祖先。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The referred Painten specimen extends the sampled genus into the earliest Tithonian; other Bavarian specimens occupy younger lithographic-limestone horizons.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Neornithes is the crown defined by the common ancestor of living birds and all descendants; Archaeopteryx is outside that crown, while Vegavis and Asteriornis require explicit fossil-placement analyses. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 今鸟类是由所有现生鸟类最近共同祖先及其全部后代定义的冠群；Archaeopteryx 位于该冠群之外，而 Vegavis 与 Asteriornis 必须依赖明确的化石位置分析。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: AMNH FARB 30899 is from a 69.2–68.4 Ma interval and the combined analysis supports waterfowl affinity; earlier conflicting placements remain explicit, while Asteriornis supplies a younger independent crown test.

definition.en: The Playa Los Lobos specimen Llallawavis scagliai supplies a named fossil for this Phorusrhacidae account. Researchers coded its skull and other anatomy in a morphology matrix to test relationships within terror birds. The same study reconstructed sensory features; those capabilities and deeper family relationships are interpretations of sampled material, not direct observations or a complete ancestor chain. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.

definition.en: The sampled *Vegavis* skull AMNH FARB 30899 comes from the 69.2–68.4 Ma interval reported for the Sandwich Bluff Member on Vega Island, Antarctica. This age belongs to the fossil-bearing unit, not a direct radiometric date on the skull or a genus-wide range. Its proposed placement near crown waterfowl depends on phylogenetic models; this specimen does not establish the first appearance of crown birds. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 所取样的 *Vegavis* 头骨 AMNH FARB 30899 来自南极 Vega 岛 Sandwich Bluff 段所报告的 69.2–68.4 Ma 区间。该年代属于含化石地层单元，不是头骨的直接放射性定年，也不是属级范围。它接近冠群水禽的位置仍依赖系统发育模型；这件标本不能确立冠群鸟类首现。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: The nearly complete skull AMNH FARB 30899 is tied to the latest Cretaceous Sandwich Bluff Member interval reported as 69.2–68.4 Ma.

definition.en: Neoaves is a navigation route through living birds. In the reviewed phylogenomic analysis, gene trees conflict around its earliest branches, and the root is treated as a hard-polytomy hypothesis: the available signal may not resolve the branching order. This is not a settled ancestor sequence or a fossil divergence date. The cited study samples living lineages but supplies no dated fossil start for a numerical range. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Neoaves 是一条通往现生鸟类的导航路径。所综述的系统基因组分析在其最早分支附近发现基因树冲突，并将根部视为硬多分叉假说：现有信号可能无法解析分支顺序。这不是已确定的祖先序列，也不是化石分化日期。所引研究取样的是现生支系，没有提供可用于数值范围的化石定年起点。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。
